question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Without a _______ package, our economy's going to go down the tubes.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"stimulus"** means something that incites or quickens action, feeling, or thought; it is something that encourages activity or growth. (प्रेरणा)

 
 
• **Example:** The government introduced a **stimulus** package to boost the economy.
 
 
 
• **"Stimulus"** refers to an external factor that influences an activity or process, especially in a positive way. (प्रेरणा)
 
 
• **Example:** The new policy acted as a **stimulus** for economic growth.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stimulating** (उत्तेजक): Providing encouragement or new ideas for something.

 
 
• **Example:** The lecture was very stimulating and gave us many ideas for our project.
 
 
 
• **Stimulated** (प्रेरित): Past tense of stimulate; to have encouraged activity or growth.
 
 
• **Example:** The new policy stimulated economic growth in the region.
 
 
 
• **Stimulant** (उत्तेजक पदार्थ): A substance that raises levels of physiological or nervous activity in the body.
 
 
• **Example:** Caffeine is a common stimulant found in coffee and tea.
